description: This file contains extension methods for configuring and registering services in an ASP.NET Core application, such as dependency injection, JWT authentication, and logging setup.

classes.name: ServicesExtensions
classes.description: Contains static extension methods to configure dependency injection, JWT authentication, and logging in an ASP.NET Core app.

methods.name: AddConduit
methods.description: Registers core services, such as MediatR, validation, AutoMapper, and application-specific services into the DI container.

methods.name: AddJwt
methods.description: Configures JWT bearer authentication, including token validation parameters and header parsing.

methods.name: AddSerilogLogging
methods.description: Sets up Serilog logging with console sink and attaches it to the logging factory.
